decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall begin not later than three years from the date of this decision.
Reason: In order to comply with Section 91 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990, as amended by Section 51 of the Planning and Compulsory Purchase Act 2004.

Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and specifications: [Unnumbered Location Plan, 101rB Ground Floor, 200 Basement Plan Existing, 200 Basement Proposed, 203 Acoustic Floor and Ceiling Details, Ceiling and wall boards and acoustic rubber materials information, Planning Report written by Jonathan Philips, Flood Risk Assessment 0170 - FRA- 003, Fire Safety Reasonable Exception Statement, Noise Impact Assessment 24101238r1 and The Living Room Brochure. Received: 23/06/2025; 1.0 Revision 00 and Addendum Report written by Jonathan Philips. Received: 19/08/2025; Unnumbered Rear Elevation Existing, Unnumbered Ground Floor Plan and Unnumbered First Floor Plan. Received: 27/08/2025 
Unnumbered Rear Elevation Proposed, Unnumbered Ground Floor Plan Proposed and Unnumbered First Floor Plan Proposed. Received: 13/10/2025].
Reason: In order to ensure the development is carried out in accordance with the planning permission.

Condition : 4 - The noise management policy, dispersal policy and mitigation
strategies shall be carried out in accordance with the hereby
approved Noise Impact Assessment, any alterations or
amendments must be agreed in writing with the Local Planning
Authority. 
Reason: In order to protect neighbours' living conditions, in
accordance with policies EQ5, CC1 and CC2 of the Local Plan.

Condition : 5 - Notwithstanding the submitted details and prior to occupation, full details (including manufacturer's specifications) of all cycle stands for the occupants of, and visitors to, the development shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The approved facilities shall be fully implemented and made available for use before any part of the development is first occupied and thereafter retained for use at all times without obstruction. 
Reason: In order to support sustainable transport objectives.
description: Retrospective permission for the change of use of the existing food takeaway business and restaurant into a lounge bar on the basement floor and restaurant on the ground floor of 299 to 303 Chiswick High Road.
